description: This Kotlin source file defines the A2UIHandler class, which manages interactions with a web-based UI component in an Android application, including URL resolution, readiness checks, and message decoding.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Handles communication with a web-based A2 UI component, providing URL resolution, readiness checking, and message processing functionalities.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if the provided URL is a trusted canvas action URL.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the full A2 UI host URL based on provided node or operator URLs.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Suspends execution until the A2 UI is ready, attempting multiple checks with delays.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes JSON-formatted messages received from the A2 UI, validating and returning as a JSON string.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates individual A2 UI message objects against version 0.8 constraints.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript to apply messages to the A2 UI.
